warnings: THIS SHEET IS THE REASON THE GRID MASTER HAS 5 DUMMY LINES. Beams land off the named grid in three places, each backed by a printed dimension on A-04: (1) row-E/row-D B2X extensions run 1.00 m past grids 1 and 4 to B1 edge beams on dummy lines 1'/4' (A-04 top chain 1.00|9.60|1.00, re-printed in the SN/EE 15.60 site chain); (2) interior B1 verticals between rows E and D sit on dummy lines 2' (1.90 from grid 1) and 3' (1.30 from grid 3) per A-04's 1.90|1.30 / 1.30|1.90 sub-chains -- these carry the WC.1/WC.2 bathroom partitions; (3) a B2 beam under the kitchen north wall sits on dummy line F' (A-04 prints 3.10 above grid E), bay 1-2 only. Positions confirmed against the drawn lines by pixel measurement (78.3 px/m) before being written into the grid master.

SEGMENTATION CHOICE (recorded per the standing order): beams are reported support-to-support. The row-E and row-D B2 segments (e.g. E-1 -> E-2) were NOT split where the dummy-line B1 partition beams bear on them at E-2'/D-2'/E-3'/D-3', because no support exists at those joints; the bearing relation is carried by bears_on_beam flags on the B1 entries instead. Same for the F' beam (bears on the grid-1/grid-2 verticals) and the porch edge B1s (bear on the B2X cantilever tips).

SLAB MARKS ARE S0/S1 WITH DIGITS, NOT LETTERS SO/SI (schema §10 check done): the S-01 structural index names sheet S-13 'S0,S1,RS1,RS2, แบบขยาย 1, ST1, ST2, ...', and the digit glyph in the slab circles matches the '1' in B1/RB1 at 4-5x zoom. S0 = slab on ground (carport area only), S1 = cast-in-place suspended slab (bathrooms, porches, เฉลียง, NW strip), SP = precast plank. Precast span directions read from the printed arrows at 4-5x: E-W (3.20 m) in the F-E and D-C bands, N-S (2.00 m) in the E-D band -- always the shorter bay dimension.

NO BEAMS south of row B except nothing -- the carport S0 slabs (B-A x 3-4 and the 1.60 m strip south of A) are on ground with thin single-line edges and no columns at their south corners; the A-3/A-4 columns exist to carry the S-05 roof beams, not a floor. The ST2 stub north of F is likewise stair-on-ground. Deliberately no dummy grids for any of these edges (§4 slab-only-edge rule).

No column marks are printed on this sheet (squares only) -- marks come from S-02/S-03, including their unresolved C1-vs-C1A dispute at C-1/C-4 (see the two footing files). Beam sections B1/B2/B2A/B2X/B3/B3A are on S-11 (แบบขยายคาน B1-B3A) -- Stage 2 joins specs via element_id; nothing was joined here.
No drawing break lines on this sheet -- checked at ~4.5x on the E-D band, F-E band and south region with grid-overlay crops (see grid master). Both dimension chains printed and close (9.60 / 14.55).
